lines.zh: 我的体节一节节动，往前滑。
lines.en: My segments move one by one and I slide forward.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面起伏，像一道浪。
lines.en: I ripple along the ground like a wave.

lines.zh: 我从土里钻出来，又钻进去。
lines.en: I come up out of the soil and go down again.
I glide over dry grass and it falls flat.
I wind along an old wall.

lines.zh: 我一边滑，一边把土带起来。
lines.en: I carry soil up as I glide.

lines.zh: 我在这片地里穿了好几圈。
lines.en: I have crossed this ground several times.

lines.zh: 骨节一节节，从地下钻出。
lines.en: Bone segments rise one by one.
I rise out of a pit.

lines.zh: 我一节一节把身体拉直。
lines.en: I straighten myself segment by segment.

lines.zh: 我在地上留下弯弯的痕。
lines.en: I leave a winding scar on the ground.
I head for the place with the living.
I enter the grass and it withers.
I rear up, taller than the trees.
I come down out of the air.
I land and a patch of soil is thrown up.
I coil on the ground, joints overlapping.

lines.zh: 我身边的东西在慢慢变色。
lines.en: Things near me are slowly changing color.
My head is raised and has not moved.

lines.zh: 有一根草在我旁边枯了。
lines.en: A blade of grass beside me has withered.
I have no hide, only bone.

lines.zh: 风穿过我的骨缝，有声音。
lines.en: Wind through my ribs makes a sound.

lines.zh: 土里有一丝动静，我听着
lines.en: A stir in the soil; I listen.
I turn my head the other way.

lines.zh: 我的尾尖在土里轻轻敲。
lines.en: My tail tip taps the soil.

lines.zh: 这片地已经不长东西了。
lines.en: Nothing grows on this ground anymore.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把一节身体松开。
lines.en: Slowly I loosen one segment.
My bones are dark.
The soil under you has gone loose.
I can reach you from here.

lines.zh: 你看我的骨头，看得太久了。
lines.en: You have looked at my bones too long.
Segment by segment, I rise from the earth.
Retreat if you like. It will do little.

lines.zh: 我一节一节从地下拱出来。
lines.en: I rise from the ground segment by segment.
Every blade here is dead.
I raised my head because I caught you.
You carry life on you. It stings.

lines.zh: 我动起来不像看着那么慢。
lines.en: I move faster than I look.
One of my segments has split.
I give a segment and rise again.

lines.zh: 裂开的那节，照样往前拱
lines.en: The split segment pushes forward all the same.
Bone knocks bone, a dull sound.
I twist my body.
What was struck sits crooked.
Slowly I straighten myself.

lines.zh: 我把这一下记在骨头里。
lines.en: I will keep that in the bone.
Another ring of grass withers.
I am still above ground.
Living warmth is worth more than this.
I can feel that living warmth.

lines.zh: 我的肚子是空的，也是骨
lines.en: My belly is hollow, and bone.
Set it on the ground.
I touched it and it withered.

lines.zh: 这些东西在我旁边都留不住。
lines.en: Nothing lasts beside me.
I want only the living.
That has no savor.

lines.zh: 我这一身节，一节节拱过来。
lines.en: Segment by segment, I arch toward you.
Do not shake. I can smell it.
You hit my bone, and it is hard.
One joint shifts; I yield half a step.
Do not step on my body.
One of my segments is pinned under your foot.
That did not stop me.
Get clear. The bone will cut.
I coil aside to let you pass.
You stepped on soil, not me.

lines.zh: 我抬起的部分又放下来。
lines.en: I lower what I had raised.

lines.zh: 你撞得我骨节错了一位。
lines.en: That knocked one joint out of line.
A thing like me needs no companion.
Other bones move in this earth.

lines.zh: 我们碰见了也不打招呼。
lines.en: When we meet, we do not greet.

lines.zh: 有一条比我短，绕了三圈。
lines.en: One is shorter than me and coils three times.
We each hold a patch of soil.
If one crosses, we collide.
After the collision we each withdraw.
This ground will not feed two.

lines.zh: 我很久没见过另一条了。
lines.en: I have not seen another in a long while.
They have probably all sunk away.

lines.zh: 我用头骨顶起一块石头。
lines.en: I lift a stone with my skull.
A flick of bone and the stone rolls away.
I wrap around it and let go.
An old bone lies there.
Not mine. I leave it.
What I touch turns dark.
I sweep it aside with my tail tip.
It has dried out. Useless.

lines.zh: 多节的骨蛇，从地下钻出来。
lines.en: A segmented bone serpent rises from underground.

lines.zh: 碰过的东西都发黑，没用
lines.en: What I touch turns black and useless.
There is a tremor in the ground.

lines.zh: 头探出地面，骨节一节节响。
lines.en: Head out of the ground, my joints click one by one.

lines.zh: 那个东西站在空地中间。
lines.en: That thing stands in the open.
It is three blocks from me.
It has not noticed the soil moving.
The soil moves; it does not notice.
I hear its heartbeat.
Good position. The soil is soft.
I draw myself in a little.
It lifted its head this way.
I rise behind it.

lines.zh: 它转身的时候，我已经到了。
lines.en: As it turned, I was already there.

lines.zh: 土一松，我的头就探出来
lines.en: The soil loosens and my head comes up.

lines.zh: 一节一节钻出来，从地底。
lines.en: Segment by segment, I rise from the ground.
It circles the open ground.
I follow beneath the ground.

lines.zh: 它每走一步，土就动一下。
lines.en: Each step it takes moves the soil.
It stops and looks down.
I hold still and let it look.
It walks on.
I raise half of myself at its side.
It heard the bone click.
It turns and backs away slowly.
Its back is against a tree.
The tree will wither soon.
I lower my head to face it.
And I raise it again.
It raises an arm over its face.

lines.zh: 骨牙合拢，卡在它锁骨上
lines.en: My bone teeth close on its collarbone.
I wrap one coil around it.
The coils tighten and it struggles.
I come down from the air.
That cracks the ground open.
I drive my skull into its chest.

lines.zh: 它伸手抓我的骨头，抓滑了。
lines.en: It grabs my bone and slips off.

lines.zh: 我的尾从下面扫它的腿。
lines.en: My tail sweeps its legs from below.

lines.zh: 它往后退，我跟着卷上去。
lines.en: It backs away and I coil after it.

lines.zh: 有一节身体被它折断了。
lines.en: It broke one segment of me.

lines.zh: 骨头从土里一节节升起。
lines.en: My bones rise out of the soil segment by segment.
The grass on the surface withers at once.
I rear up, taller than the saplings.

lines.zh: 风穿过我的身体，有回声。
lines.en: Wind passes through me and echoes.
This ground is mine now.
I turn a full circle and look around.
My bones are the color of soil.
I come down and the soil sinks.
A few birds flew off.
I coil and wait.
Fire passed over the bone and blackened it.

lines.zh: 我从空中掉下，摔散了半截。
lines.en: I fell from the air and half my length scattered.
The soil turned to mud and I sank.

lines.zh: 爆响把我的骨节震散了。
lines.en: The blast shook my joints apart.

lines.zh: 箭杆断在肋骨间，我不拔
lines.en: The shaft breaks between my ribs; I leave it.
Strange light crawls along my bones.

lines.zh: 这片地已经没有活物了。
lines.en: There is nothing living on this ground.

lines.zh: 雷顺着我的骨走了一遍。
lines.en: Lightning ran the length of my bones.
The soil is gone and I am falling.
